conclusion.reason: Repeated canonical replay is structurally multiplied, but current public ports combine calculation with current admission and final rereads. Removing a whole binding/replay/coverage phase cannot be justified as equivalent from these contracts alone. W11 batching lowers per-resolution work but does not collapse the four successful verifier invocations of a cold persistent read.
conclusion.safeSmallCandidate: Within synchronous finalization/validation only, precompute full canonical digests once and perform stable first-occurrence dedup/membership with Set. This changes no port call, authority read, numeric calculation, ordering, coverage state or output. It has no measured material impact and is not proposed as a timeout fix.
conclusion.performanceClaim: No claim that W11 batching, W12 bootstrap splitting, W14 renewal inputs or any proposed micro-optimization meets the 300000ms cold-test budget. The W12 split affects persistence-recovery, not this WP05 fixture path.
conclusion.action: Keep current semantics. If diagnosis is needed in the next already-authorized focused hosted selection, add phase/call timing that does not substitute, cache or skip any producer invocation. Do not add a separate equivalent run or increase timeout.

outerCallCounts.assumptions: Successful stable new-save path, two endpoints, exact certificate available. Early denial/unavailable paths stop earlier. Counts are static call-site counts, not instrumentation.
outerCallCounts.outerLimit: Excludes fixture setup, explicit test witness previews and issuer.resolve, explicit stored-sample reads, denied read and cleanup; confirmed also performs another evaluateAndStore.
outerCallCounts.directC08Formula: One cold persistent.read: 2 direct sensitivity reads + 4 sensitivity reads inside two binding.reads + (1+n) validateSamples reads + 4*(4+n) verifier source/baseline/sample reads = 23+5n =33 for n=2. Nested issuer/preview/C08 verification adds more.

nestedDependencyMultipliers.counts: 2 single-baseline scenarios.resolve calls,1 real simulateScenario and source/coverage ingress+egress checks. Each single-reference resolve performs2 case reads and1 compareForecast. In this WP05 fixture, each case read invokes operation verification for2 alternatives twice; each operation verifier performs2 compareForecast calls and1 readonly simulation transaction. Therefore one successful preview entails4 case reads,16 operation-verifier invocations and34 compareForecast calls before other producer internals.
nestedDependencyMultipliers.limit: Static API-call count, not CPU/IO duration or database-query count.

nestedDependencyMultipliers.counts: Two pair resolvePlannerScenarioBatch calls share a case observation within each batch phase. Same-case pair gives4 case reads across both batches, plus2 direct cases.read =6;4 direct compareForecast projections, plus48 compareForecast calls from those6 case reads =52. It also makes12 C08 read calls before producer internals. units.resolve adds1 case read and1 C08 read around its issue.
nestedDependencyMultipliers.limit: The optimization is invocation-local and does not share observations across separate issue/resolve/preview invocations.

nestedDependencyMultipliers.counts: A C08 read performs initial/final stored+case observations, fresh verifySources/authorizeCase and final host revalidation. Repeated C08 reads are not only digest lookups.
nestedDependencyMultipliers.limit: No permission result may be reused as a numeric-cache shortcut.

optimizationAssessment.candidate: Remove one bindings.read or replace repeated verifySensitivity with a memo
optimizationAssessment.reason: The initial and final binding observations currently bracket sample/result reads and detect binding mutation; each canonical binding read also rechecks current rule/result and invokes numerical reproduction. The public port exposes no cheaper authenticated stable binding observation. Removing a phase changes those guarantees; cross-call memo remains explicitly rejected.

optimizationAssessment.candidate: Drop qualify/verify duplicate previews or interval revalidation
optimizationAssessment.reason: Public qualify must check an incoming preview against a fresh producer replay; verify must check issued qualification against current authority and regenerated qualification. A private fusion might be designed, but equivalence across callback mutation and intermediate authority changes has not been established. Do not delete current/final checks or replace real preview with stored qualification.

optimizationAssessment.candidate: Precompute canonical digests inside synchronous output finalization and membership validation
optimizationAssessment.mechanism: Stable first-occurrence Set of full digestSfValue keys, computed once per reference within the same synchronous section; for certificate membership compute the Set only after the awaited witness previews, then evaluate the same equality predicate. Preserve reference order and the exact full-object equality (not merely refId/refDigest). Do not retain the Set across await, factory calls or future requests.
optimizationAssessment.effect: Removes repeated canonical serialization/hashing in nested findIndex/some; worst-case O(R^2) digest evaluations becomes O(R). No producer, case, evidence, rule or authority read is removed. These fixtures have few unique sources, so meaningful runtime improvement is unproven and likely bounded.

optimizationAssessment.candidate: Parallelize or hold a long transaction around whole replay
optimizationAssessment.reason: Mutable callback providers, serialized LocalStore transactions and final-read ordering need a separate proof; holding BEGIN during exact probes/coverage would recreate the rejected lock-scope approach. Existing supported Promise.all reads remain unchanged.

nextHostedInstrumentationOnlyIfNeeded.safety: Wrappers may time and count the real call and its finally path only. They must preserve callback arguments, cloned observations, exceptions and authority checks. Do not cache results or execute local product code. Whole exact-call time can be measured without wrapping its internal solver or changing its producer wiring.
nextHostedInstrumentationOnlyIfNeeded.runPolicy: Attach diagnosis to the next approved disjoint hosted selection; no separate equivalent CI dispatch by this reviewer.
